definition_reference.title: OpenAI Harness Engineering: using Codex in an agent-first world
definition_reference.poly_trader_translation: Human steers; heartbeat agents execute inside repo-native maps, tools, observability, mechanical constraints, and review loops.

required_docs.role: short agent map, not an encyclopedia
current plan and next gates only

question_gates.question: Do I have the shortest usable repo map and dirty-file boundary?
What is this run's human intent and what must not be changed?
What are the current-live, research, venue/source, and governance truths?
Is the blocker a strategy/data issue or a harness capability gap?
What is the smallest testable and rollback-safe patch?
How can another agent verify the result without trusting the author?
Are current-state docs synchronized by overwrite instead of append-only history?
If the same blocker fails again, what harness capability or architecture path changes?
If the same semantic signature or support delta repeats, what forced execution branch prevents another observation-only heartbeat?
required_evidence: same semantic signature or blocker repeat count
selected forced branch: Map/Signal redesign, customer-safe shadow proof, venue lifecycle proof, bounded live-canary prep, or hard no-go
bounded live-canary policy evidence or single failed gate

question_gates.question: Can the user understand completion, verification, blockers, and next gate within 30 seconds?

agent_readable_signals.name: previous_pm_heartbeat_handoff
agent_readable_signals.purpose: PM heartbeat conclusions and decisions that must be carried into the next engineering heartbeat before choosing P0/P1 work

agent_readable_signals.name: current_live_truth
agent_readable_signals.purpose: current runtime blocker, live bucket, support route, fail-closed state

agent_readable_signals.name: paper_shadow_outcome_reconciliation_truth
agent_readable_signals.purpose: rerunnable paper/shadow 24h outcome proof with schema-v2 top-level/quick_read pending, ETA, resolved, label-replay, and fail-closed fields; heartbeat refreshes it before PM/docs consume it and verifies API/artifact consistency

agent_readable_signals.name: customer_safe_alternative_truth
agent_readable_signals.purpose: customer-safe alternative-solution proof, selected next customer artifact, alias/count quick-read, fail-closed flags, and strict overview/artifact consistency before docs call the safe lane usable

agent_readable_signals.name: active_backend_health_truth
agent_readable_signals.purpose: active API process freshness, head sync status, startup continuity status, and stale backend restart requirement before trusting API payloads

agent_readable_signals.name: strategy_data_freshness_truth
agent_readable_signals.purpose: raw/features/labels/strategy freshness and bounded maintenance result for no-collect heartbeats before treating Strategy Lab evidence as current

agent_readable_signals.name: recent_drift_truth
agent_readable_signals.purpose: recent weighted IC, pathological windows, regime concentration

agent_readable_signals.name: deployment_candidate_truth
agent_readable_signals.purpose: walk-forward OOS top-k deployment gate, fail-closed candidate tier, and strict API/artifact consistency for Strategy Lab

agent_readable_signals.name: venue_readiness_truth
agent_readable_signals.purpose: venue proof state, dry-run lifecycle checklist, runtime readiness blockers, status-level and overview-level live-canary policy gate visibility, operator next action, artifact-first API overview/status source, and strict API consistency proof

agent_readable_signals.name: anti_equilibrium_execution_truth
agent_readable_signals.purpose: forced branch evidence when support delta is zero or the same blocker/signature repeats; prevents observation-only heartbeat loops

mechanical_invariants.description: All entrypoint and required docs exist.
Contract and QA playbook contain every HQ0-HQ8 gate.
AGENTS.md links to docs/ai-collaboration/HEARTBEAT.md and docs/ai-collaboration/harness/README.md without becoming a giant manual.
Runtime API verification includes scripts/active_backend_health_probe.py --strict so stale active backends fail before operator proofs are trusted.
README.md lists docs/ai-collaboration/harness as a first-class documentation entry.

docs/ai-collaboration/HEARTBEAT.md, QA, contract, checker, and current-state docs require a forced branch when same semantic signature/support delta=0 repeats; observation-only status refresh is incomplete.
--no-collect heartbeat summaries record strategy_data_sync_maintenance, and the runner triggers bounded strategy data sync when freshness is stale or within the configured stale headroom.

verification_commands: git diff --check -- AGENTS.md docs/ai-collaboration/AI_AGENT_ROLE.md docs/ai-collaboration/HEARTBEAT.md ARCHITECTURE.md README.md docs/ai-collaboration/harness scripts/heartbeat_harness_check.py tests/test_heartbeat_harness_contract.py
